# Changes to the Sweet cursors

[Sweet-cursors](Sweet-cursors) is a copy of `kde/cursors/Sweet-cursors` from [EliverLara/Sweet](https://github.com/EliverLara/Sweet), branch `dark-plasma-6`, at commit `fa5229183093c078bebbc1b405d78909ffa18bb4`.

### 0.0.1, 2026-10-22, lukk17

1. Copied without changes, symbolic links kept. The theme name stays `Sweet-cursors`. The copy is the same as the owner's `~/.icons/Sweet-cursors`.
2. (2026-11-10) Added [source](source), the editable source of the cursors from the same upstream commit, unchanged: `kde/cursors/src` as [source/src](source/src) and `kde/cursors/build.sh` as [source/build.sh](source/build.sh), 51 files. Every file has the same git blob hash as upstream. `build.sh` makes the cursors with Inkscape and xcursorgen into `source/build` and `source/Sweet-cursors`, and the project `.gitignore` keeps both out of git. The package does not install the source.
